trigger.what: Amazon opened Prime Fall submissions with a 20% minimum discount and a hard Aug 21 close.
Incrementality Engine finished re-scoring last Q4: the headline 20%-off event measured 31% incremental after trough accounting, not the 58% gross lift reported at the time.
Conflict Detector found 14 SKUs proposed in both the DTC early-BF window and the Walmart deal window, and pinned the card.

constraints.label: MAP
constraints.detail: No price below MAP on any channel, in any event, including clearance. Platform-funded discounts are fine; ours stop at the floor.

constraints.label: Marketplace deal requirements
constraints.detail: Prime Fall needs a 20% minimum discount off the 30-day median and 500 units committed per SKU. Walmart Deal Days needs 15% and a clean 30-day price history.

constraints.label: Inventory commitments
constraints.detail: Units pledged to a marketplace deal are reserved and cannot be sold through another channel during the window. Planner holds the reservation.

constraints.label: Price-history integrity
constraints.detail: No pre-event price raise to manufacture a deeper discount. The 30-day median is the reference and it is audited by both platforms.
